question: Which of the following books was NOT written by Jyotiba Phule?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Untouchables**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Untouchables was **not written by Jyotiba Phule.**
 
• **Jyotiba Phule wrote Gulamgir**i, Shetkaryacha Asud, and other books. 
 
• Jyotirao Govindrao Phule (1827-1890)** was a social reformer and writer from Maharashtra, India.**
 
• He was a** leader of the non-Brahmin movemen**t and fought against caste restrictions.
 
• He also worked for** women's education and the rights of low-caste people. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Untouchables**

 
 
• This refers to the group of people historically known as "Dalits" or "untouchables" in the caste system of India.
 
• The term was used by social reformers to describe those outside the traditional four-fold caste system.
 
 
 
• **Gulamgiri**
 
 
• **"Gulamgiri"** (translated as "Slavery") is a famous book written by **Jyotirao Phule** in 1873.
 
• In this work, Phule critiques the social structure of caste discrimination and exposes the exploitation of the lower castes by the higher castes and the Brahminical system.
 
 
 
• **Shetkaryacha Asud**
 
 
• **"Shetkaryacha Asud"** (translated as "The Farmer’s Whipcord") is a Marathi book written by **Narayan Meghaji Lokhande**.
 
• The book is a call to action for the rights and betterment of farmers, focusing on their struggles and exploitation.
 
 
 
• **Brahmananche Kasab**
 
 
• **"Brahmananche Kasab"** (translated as "The Brahmin's Slave") is another work by **Jyotirao Phule**.
 
• It critiques the upper caste Brahmins who held power and perpetuated the social and economic exploitation of lower castes.
